articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Ford Q1 Sales Slide Raises Questions On EV Plans And Valuation. Ford Motor (NYSE:F) reported a nearly 9% decline in Q1 U.S. sales, linked to affordability pressures and inventory issues. A fire at a key aluminum supplier affected vehicle availability, contributing to production constraints during the quarter. Electric vehicle sales fell, while sales of larger SUVs rose and Ford's U.S. market share edged higher.
